title: On the Gap Between the Co-Indices of a Free Z_2-Space and Its Suspension
summary: For a free $\mathbb{Z}_2$-space $X$, the co-index $\mathrm{coind}(X)$ is the largest integer $m$ for which there exists a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-equivariant map $S^m \to X$, where $S^m$ carries the antipodal action. Since suspension sends such a map to a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-equivariant map $S^{m+1}\to S(X),$ one always has $$\mathrm{coind}(S(X)) \geq \mathrm{coind}(X)+1.$$ We prove that the excess over this lower bound can be arbitrarily large.
